text_block_list.text:
One day during summer training camp. She 
continued to tackle 
the grueling training regimen I had 
assigned her.
choice_data_list: All right, that's set five done!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Whew. Another day finished, then.
choice_data_list: Great work! How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Not a single issue. 
Neither in body nor spirit.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I shall see through everything you demand 
of me— 
without fail.

Phalaenopsis's gaze was brimming with 
resolve. 
She still had all the motivation in the 
world, but even so—
choice_data_list: (It's about time she took a break.)

(Maybe it's about time she took a 
break...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, there she is! Phalaeno-saaan!

Just as I was thinking that... 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi and Special Week 
ran over to where she was standing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um! Are you free after this? 
If you'd like, how about trying "SUP" 
together?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, do you know what "SUP" is...? 
It's this thing where you do yoga on top 
of, 
like, a really big surfboard!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It sounded like it'd be so much fun with 
everyone! 
Please come! What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Or we could go for the "Giant Shaved Ice" 
instead! 
We found a totally insane one! 
Let's take on the challenge together!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
After all, nothing says summer like shaved 
ice, right?! 
This year, I'm definitely finishing it 
without getting brain freeze!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...What brought this on so suddenly, you 
two? 
Why invite me to go play all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Well, seeing how hard you've been 
working lately, Phalaeno-san, 
it feels like you're pushing yourself too 
far... and I got worried...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So... I'm sorry. 
Even if it's none of my business, please 
let me say it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a break together! 
So we can keep giving it our all tomorrow, 
full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Spe...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. If you insist that much, 
let us take a breather.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, we did it, Spe-chan! 
Told ya, didn't I? If you just tell her 
how you feel, 
she'll definitely answer back!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! What a relief...! 
Thanks for giving me that push, 
Tsuru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Still, "SUP" or "shaved ice"... Hmm. 
Both sound enticing, but which should we 
choose?
choice_data_list:
I hear that "Giant Shaved Ice" really is 
massive.
They say "SUP" is great for relaxing!

text_block_list.name: Beach Shack Owner
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, one "Giant Shaved Ice" coming 
up! There's a ton 
of it, so take your time and share it, all 
right?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What insane size is this, desu?! 
Just how many bowls of shaved ice went 
into this?!!
choice_data_list:
Looks like it could easily be ten normal 
servings...!

Looks like it could easily be ten normal 
servings...!

text_block_list.text:
For the time being, we chipped away at the 
giant shaved ice 
and spooned it into individual cups. Once 
it finally looked like 
proper shaved ice, everyone began to eat, 
but—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El has realized something dreadful. 
—If we don't hurry up and eat this 
together, 
this giant shaved ice is going to turn 
into plain sweet water!!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Right... Then while watching out for brain 
freeze, 
we'd better hurr—*cough* *hack*!! 
*Cough*, *cough*!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Never mind the headache, that cough is 
dreadful. 
Here, drink some warm tea.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A brain freeze countermeasure! El is 
completely prepared, deesu! 
Drizzle on some Salsa Vida to make the 
shaved ice hot! 
If it's spicy, then the brain freeze will—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
OWWW-OW-OW-OW-OW-OUCH?! 
Why is this happening, deeesu?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Phalaeno-san. El and Tsuru-chan have 
fallen. 
Now that it has come to this—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We have no choice but to avenge 
them. 
Let us do this, Grass.

text_block_list.name: Phalaeno & Grass
text_block_list.text: *Nom, nom, nom, nom, nom.*

text_block_list.name: Phalaeno & Grass
text_block_list.text:
"There is no issue whatsoever." 
"Yes, we are quite all right~"

text_block_list.name: Phalaeno & Grass
text_block_list.text:
"None in the slightest." 
"Indeed. No need to worr—~"

The two suppress the headache through 
sheer mental fortitude. 
Whether to call that stoic endurance or—
choice_data_list: (They're kind of alike in that way...)

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the heroic efforts of 
Phalaenopsis and Grass Wonder, 
the four of them somehow managed to finish 
the giant shaved ice 
before it completely melted away.

And so, the day after spending 
such a fun time with her classmates...

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
SUP stands for "Stand Up Paddleboard." 
Today, we'll be doing yoga on top of the 
boards! 
It's very relaxing!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! For a first-class lady, 
balancing on top of a board is mere 
child's play! 
Feast your eyes upon King's magnificent 
form!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Poke, poke. Poke, poke.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wha—?! Sky-san?! 
Stop, don't use your paddle—you idiot!! 
Stop poking other people's boards!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whaaat?! King-chan's drifting right 
toward me?! 
W-Wait! If you hit me, I'll fall in~!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Spe... Now, Spe. In doing so, you're 
drifting 
toward me. Keep your distance... Spe!
(SPLAAAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm so sorry! Even though 
Phalaeno-san was 
focusing so nicely on her yoga...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Heh... Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You classmates truly never cease 
to amuse me.

And so, the day after spending 
such a fun time with her classmates...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*... Alright, next!

text_block_list.name: King & Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I'm not done yet!" 
"...Phew. Next up is—"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...A stark contrast from yesterday. They 
all bear 
the gaze of true competitors, clad in the 
aura of champions.

It seems they are pushing themselves to 
the limit for the final 
jewel of the Classic Triple Crown—the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: They're amazing, aren't they, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan told Phalaeno-chan she ought to 
rest, 
but even though she gave that advice... 
she could stand to take a break herself 
once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yet none of them ever slow down. 
They just charge straight toward the 
future they desire.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: That's what makes them shine so brightly.

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi had been resting since 
her May debut. 
Even now, she had to pause frequently 
during training, 
which had to be frustrating for her, but—

Her eyes as she watched her classmates 
were unwavering. 
Her resolve to catch up to them one day 
was unmistakable.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Tsuyoshi speaks the truth. What is 
truly admirable 
about Spe and the others may be their 
sheer sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Single-minded devotion. For the sake of 
their deepest dreams, 
they "look neither left nor right." Such 
are my peers.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And it's precisely because they push 
like that 
—that they all have real results to show 
for it.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: El-chan and Grass-chan are the same way.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan suffered a fracture earlier 
this year, 
but she made it back in time for the 
camp's second half 
and is already setting her sights on the 
next race.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
El-chan had a stellar run in the NHK Mile 
Cup, too. 
Now she's training with her sights set on 
the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, my peers are a dazzling 
kaleidoscope of blooms, 
each radiating their own brilliant light.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Now, shall we begin as well?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I must not fall behind their brilliance. 
—Hah!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, does she really not realize it?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
From where I'm standing, 
Phalaeno-chan—having proven 
herself so brilliantly on the Tiara route—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: is one of those shining lights herself.

Inspired by her peers, 
Phalaenopsis shone all the more 
brilliantly. 
I found myself looking forward to their 
future.
